import json, re, random, sys, time
import chess

RULES = [(re.compile(p), r) for p, r in json.load(open("/tmp/obench-cell-v4miy3_s/bench_opencode_regex-chess_0i4ql8j9/re.json"))]


def run(fen):
    for p, r in RULES:
        fen = p.sub(r, fen)
    return [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in fen.split("\n")]


def expected(fen):
    b = chess.Board(fen)
    out = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN:
            continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(m)
        out.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return out


def check(fen):
    ours = run(fen)
    exp = expected(fen)
    ok = len(ours) == len(exp) and all(
        x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" in exp for x in ours)
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL", fen)
        print(" ours", sorted(ours))
        print(" exp ", sorted(exp))
    return ok


ex = "<REDACTED_B64> w kq - 0 1"
print(run(ex))
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0)
n = fails = 0
t0 = time.time()
for g in range(400):
    b = chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply() < 200:
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE:
            n += 1
            if not check(b.fen()):
                fails += 1
                if fails > 5:
                    sys.exit(1)
        moves = list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias towards captures/castling/ep/promotions for coverage
        special = [m for m in moves if b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m) or m.promotion or b.is_capture(m)]
        b.push(random.choice(special) if special and random.random() < 0.3 else random.choice(moves))
print(n, "positions", fails, "fails", time.time() - t0, "s")
